Jordan (CS): Quick flag — Caldera Labs onboarding. Their chat p50 jumped from ~180ms -> 420ms overnight. Also token cost is ~12% higher than baseline. Anyone have a recommandation for a fast, reversible perf win? :thinking:
Mira Chen: ouch. any changes to routing or recent model swaps? do they use routing across regions?
Jordan (CS): They roll on `redwood-standard` route, eu-west primary, fallthrough -> hosted-small. No manual model swaps. Last deploy note says 'autotune enabled' at 13:04 UTC yesterday.
Alex Park: likely autoscaling/batching shift. Can you share samples of request sizes and sequences? prefix lengths matter. small sample helps suggest quant/model changes.
Samir Patel: I pulled a brief from their telemetry: median input len 64, 95th 420, bursty traffic during 09:00-10:00 UTC. Also KV cache hit rate ~72% which seems low for their use.
Renee - Solutions: Quick ideas: 1) try 8-bit quant (int8) for their 13B variant on a canary route — should cut cost ~20% and improve token throughput; 2) add a prefix cache policy bump for repeated conversation starters; 3) route EU bursts to a lower-latency dedicated instance if available.
Mira Chen: agree. I'd phrase it as a three-step playbook we can propose in the enablement call: small canary quant -> routing tweak -> cache tuning. Low blast radius.
Jordan (CS): For the canary, exact command? we want something ops-safe we can hand to devs.
Alex Park: Use this to spin a canary route config snippet (internal):
```
route: caldera-canary-int8
model: redwood-13b:v2-int8
percent: 5
fallback: redwood-13b:v2
policies:
  - type: autoscale
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 3
```
Start at 5% traffic, monitor latency/cost for 2 hours. If regressions -> roll back (route percent -> 0).
Samir Patel: On caching: bump conversation prefix lifetime to 30s for their main route and enable `kv_cache_aggressive` for short-turn exchanges. That should raise effective hit rate fast.
Jordan (CS): Any risk to output quality with int8 for their few-shot prompts? Caldera uses 3-shot examples in most requests.
Alex Park: small risk for edge-case hallucinations. Suggest we add a small eval harness: run 200 canonical prompts through int8 canary vs baseline and check a) token delta b) top-1 diffs. If >2% meaningful deltas, pause. We can automate that in the canary checklist.
Renee - Solutions: I'll draft the email + playbook for customer call — includes the canary config, cache tweak, and a tiny eval test. Also propose an enablement session next Tue to walk their infra team through rollback and metrics to watch (:chart_with_upwards_trend:).
Mira Chen: timelines? Jordan, can you get approval from the customer for 5% canary and the eval run today?
Jordan (CS): Reached out — Caldera said ok for canary + eval window this afternoon. I'll send the playbook once Renee posts it.
ops-bot: Canary route `caldera-canary-int8` created and receiving 4% traffic — monitoring enabled.
Alex Park: I'll keep an eye on perf dashboards. Ping me if latency stays >300ms after 1h and I'll propose routing fallback to `hosted-small` for bursts.
Jordan (CS): Perfect. Thanks team — I'll follow up with the customer summary and attach the eval results once ready. :thumbsup:
